test_title: PYST 19: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. There has been / an increase of the number / of road / accidents recently.
solution:
The correct answer is option **1) an increase of the number**.
